subject: Encryption & KMS follow-up — FinTech Co. discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fintech.co>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Encryption & KMS follow-up — FinTech Co. discovery

Hi Alice — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of requirements you mentioned:
- PII scope: customer names, masked SSNs, payment tokens, and transaction metadata.
- Data retention: 7 years for transaction records, 2 years for customer support transcripts.
- Logging controls: access logs required for audit; need to redact sensitive fields from application logs.
- Data residency: primary storage in us-east-1; backups must not replicate to other regions.
- Encryption: must have TLS in transit, at-rest encryption, and support for customer-managed keys (CMEK) or HSM for higher assurance.

Redwood fit & options (high level):
- In-transit: All hosted endpoints use TLS 1.2+/modern ciphers.
- At-rest: data at rest is encrypted by default. For hosted API, we use provider-managed keys.
- Customer-managed keys (CMEK) / HSM: supported in our Private and Dedicated deployments. We offer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and can support BYOK flows; HSM/CloudHSM integration available for higher compliance needs.
- Logging & retention: we can provide audit logs and configurable retention for logs and request traces. For hosted plans, we can limit what is logged and provide PII redaction patterns; for Dedicated/Private you get full control and no cross-tenant access.

Attachments: I attached a short security brief that summarizes these options and our deployment modes.

Proposed next steps:
1) We can answer your vendor security questionnaire — please send it (or attach it to this thread).
2) Schedule a technical deep dive with Dev (cc'd) to walk KMS/CMEK flows and data residency controls.
3) If you prefer, we can scope a Private deployment proof-of-concept for your timeline (you mentioned wanting something in the next 8 weeks).

Would you like to schedule the deep dive this week or early next?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: redwood-security-brief.pdf (1.2MB)

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@fintech.co>

Date: 2026-08-15T16:18:00-07:00

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications and our asks: 

- Data residency: us-east-1 only for primary data and backups stored in us-east-1 (no cross-region replication).
- CMEK requirement: we require customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption for production workloads. Prefer AWS KMS or CloudHSM; we'd like to understand whether keys can be in our AWS account or whether Redwood must manage them.
- Audit logs: we need immutable access logs for all key usage and admin actions for at least 1 year.
- Logging redaction: request guidance on patterns for removing PII from request/response logs (especially full SSNs).

I attached our vendor security questionnaire. Our security team would like short, specific answers for the KMS/CMEK options and whether a Private/Dedicated deployment is necessary to meet these requirements.

Timeline: We'd like a technical call next week and responses to the questionnaire within 3 business days if possible.

Best,
Alice Morgan
Head of Security & Compliance | FinTech Co.
alice.morgan@fintech.co

Attachment: Security_Questionnaire_FinTechCo.docx

Folks — forwarding Alice's email and questionnaire. Can you help draft concise answers for the questionnaire and confirm the recommended architecture? Key asks from customer: CMEK with keys in their AWS account or BYOK/HSM, us-east-1 residency, immutable key usage logs for 1 year, and guidance on log redaction.

Notes / suggested items to cover in the response:
- Hosted API: TLS in transit; provider-managed keys at rest. No customer key support on standard hosted tier.
- Dedicated: Can offer CMEK via customer KMS in a dedicated VPC with keys in customer's AWS account (we rotate envelope keys; customer retains CMK control & audit logs).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): Full BYOK and CloudHSM support; keys can be provisioned in customer's account or a customer-managed HSM.
- Key management: We use envelope encryption; CMKs are called to decrypt data-encryption keys; we log key usage events and can export CloudTrail-style logs for 1+ years for Dedicated/Private. For hosted, we can provide limited usage logs but not customer CMKs.
- HSM: For customers requiring FIPS 140-2/3 attestation, we can integrate with CloudHSM or on-prem HSM as part of a Private deployment.

Can you also prepare a one-pager (CMEK_guide.pdf) that we can send to Alice explaining step-by-step: options, timeline, and what requires Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted? I can attach it to the reply.

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Alice — thanks for the details and the questionnaire. High-level answers below; happy to expand in the technical deep dive (can you confirm a 60-min slot next Tue or Wed?).

1) Data residency
- We can scope a Dedicated or Private deployment with primary storage restricted to us-east-1. Backups are configurable to stay in us-east-1 for Dedicated/Private. For hosted API, we currently cannot guarantee single-region-only backups at the SLA level.

2) CMEK / Key ownership
- Hosted API: provider-managed keys only (no CMEK).
- Dedicated: supports CMEK where the customer can provision CMKs in their AWS account and grant Redwood's role access for envelope encryption. You retain full control of the CMKs and can revoke access.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): supports BYOK and HSM, including CloudHSM or on-prem HSM integration. This option gives you the strongest assurance and keeps key material under your direct control.

3) Key usage logs & auditability
- For Dedicated/Private, we export detailed key usage events and administrative actions to your CloudTrail (or equivalent) and retain logs for 1 year by default; retention can be extended. These logs are immutable once written to your account.
- For hosted API, we can provide operational logs but cannot export CMK usage events tied to a customer key in their account.

4) Encryption in transit & at rest
- In-transit: TLS 1.2+ for all endpoints; mTLS available for Private deployments.
- At-rest: envelope encryption with data-encryption keys encrypted by CMKs (customer-managed where applicable).

5) Log redaction & PII handling
- We can implement PII redaction rules at the ingestion layer (regex-based or field-based). For hosted customers, we can apply standard redaction patterns; for Dedicated/Private you get full control of redaction rules and no cross-tenant visibility. Dev will pair with your engineers to validate patterns for SSNs and tokens.

Attachments: CMEK_guide.pdf (one-pager with recommended architecture & next steps).

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether you prefer Dedicated (CMEK, managed by Redwood in your AWS account) or Private (full BYOK/HSM, customer-managed infra).
- I'll schedule a technical deep dive with Dev; suggest Tue 2026-08-18 10:00am PT or Wed 2026-08-19 9:00am PT — which works for you?
- We'll respond to the questionnaire items you've attached in a follow-up email with short answers mapped to each question (target: within 48 business hours after the deep dive).

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
